Employees get 22 days of annual leave per calendar year.[hb-07-chunk-0]
Source [hb-07-chunk-0]: "Annual leave policy: employees get 22 days of annual leave per calendar year. Leave requests must be made two weeks in advance in HR portal."

Passwords need to be changed every 90 days.[hb-05-chunk-0]
Source [hb-05-chunk-0]: "Passwords must be changed every 90 days and must contain at least 12 characters."

The yearly training budget per employee is 800 EUR. [hb-08-chunk-0]
Source [hb-08-chunk-0]: "Each employee has a training budget of 800 EUR per year for courses, conferences and certifications."

Up to 5 business days. [hb-01-chunk-1]

You can work remotely up to 3 days per week. [hb-03-chunk-0]
Source [hb-03-chunk-0]: "Remote work: employees can work remotely up to 3 days per week."
Source [hb-03-chunk-2]: "Remote work days can be moved within same week."

IT support hours are from 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday. [hb-10-chunk-0]
Source [hb-10-chunk-0]: "IT support hours are 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday. Contact support through IT portal or by phone."

Travel receipts must be submitted within 30 days of your return, through finance app. [hb-04-chunk-0]
Source [hb-04-chunk-0]: "Business travel must be approved before booking. Travel receipts must be submitted within 30 days of your return, through finance app."
Source [hb-04-chunk-1]: "Keep original receipts for hotels and flights. Daily allowances follow national rules for each destination."

Request a replacement laptop in the IT portal under Hardware. Handover can take up to 5 business days after manager approval. [hb-01-chunk-1][hb-01-chunk-2]
Source [hb-01-chunk-1]: "After manager approval, a replacement laptop is set up by IT staff with your files, accounts, email and access rights, and handover can take up to 5 business days."
Source [hb-01-chunk-2]: "Report lost or stolen devices to security first. Request a replacement laptop in IT portal under Hardware."
